schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: detached_kwargs(os_name=None) — the Popen keywords for a background child that outlives its parent and opens no console window (Windows: DETACHED_PROCESS | CREATE_NO_WINDOW | CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP; elsewhere start_new_session). background_python(os_name=None, executable=None) — the interpreter to spawn with: inside a venv on Windows the base interpreter named by pyvenv.cfg home, because the venv's Scripts\python.exe is a launcher that starts the real interpreter as a child.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: Akien said 'you keep spinning up python windows, you have at least 4 open now'; of 4 python processes bin/cairn's lazy-init started, the two children owned a console window and their venv launchers did not. Six Popen sites each hand-built their own flags (start_new_session alone, a no-op on NT), and the one that passed the Windows flags still showed a window. One helper replaces six hand-built flag sets (Law 1) and a proof greps for the bare form (Law 4).
entry: BUILT, ticket 0156856b1fae, 2026-11-12. The launcher hypothesis (the venv launcher is why the flagged site still showed a window) is a HYPOTHESIS until the proof's tooth 2 has run on Windows; the interpreter choice follows that measurement.
invoke: `from cairn.tools.windowless_spawn.windowless_spawn import background_python, detached_kwargs`; `subprocess.Popen([background_python(), '-m', mod], **detached_kwargs(), stdout=fh, stderr=fh)`. Prove: `python cairn/tools/windowless_spawn/proofs/test_a_cairn_spawn_opens_no_console_window.py` (add --no-spawn to skip the tooth that spawns a process).
state_and_history: A TOOL HOLDS NO STATE OF ITS OWN (Law 6): it returns a dict and a path and spawns nothing itself.
proof: proofs/test_a_cairn_spawn_opens_no_console_window.py — tooth 1: the nt kwargs carry CREATE_NO_WINDOW and DETACHED_PROCESS and no start_new_session, the posix kwargs the reverse, and background_python returns the caller's own interpreter, so a spawned child sees the caller's site-packages (its sys.prefix equals the parent's); tooth 2: a child spawned through the helper leaves no console host in its process tree (Windows only; UNMEASURED elsewhere); tooth 3: none of the six sites hand-builds start_new_session or creationflags.
gates: Import gate — encapsulation_holds in build_inspector (RULE 1) reds any reach landing off this tool's declared module. Seal: the tester seals the proof into validations/ beside it.
falsifier: Red if a Cairn-spawned background process on Windows owns a console window, if any of the six sites hand-builds a flag set again, or if this charter stops declaring exactly its module.
how_it_learns: It does not; it is a fixed primitive — one place where the spawn flags are decided.
traces_to: CP4 and Law 3 (a measured defect on the user's box)
Law 1 and Law 4 (one helper in place of six hand-built flag sets, enforced by a proof)
Law 6 (a tool has users, not an owner)
owner: None — a tool has users (Law 6): every component that spawns a background child. CC gates writes to its code and proofs.
